Tasty Thai Food and Friendly Service
Jun 2026 • Couples
Overall, a good Thai restaurant with tasty food and a pleasant atmosphere. The Pad Krapow (Pad Kha Pao) was okay, flavorful but not particularly memorable. My favorite dish was definitely the glass noodles with prawns; the noodles were well-seasoned, the prawns were fresh, and the dish had great texture and flavor. Service was friendly, and I’d come back to try more items from the menu.
